text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day to run alongside Oguri Cap in the 
Senior Year has arrived. With Mejiro Ardan 
also in the field, all eyes are on how far 
Inari One can push through.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Oguri Cap's peak condition, Inari 
One broke into a cold sweat. Even so, she 
steeled herself, knowing she had to win.
